Up to 100% Second Chance Bet

(Available on Select Days. Check Your Rewards Tab!)

Promotional Terms and Conditions

Starts: 12:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, July 1, 2026

Ends: 11:59 p.m. ET on Thursday, December 31, 2026

Payout: Bonus Bet Token will be loaded to qualifying Bally Bet Patrons' accounts within 24 hours of their wager settling as a loss.

Place a qualifying real-money wager using a Second Chance Bet Token. If your Qualifying Wager results in a loss, receive a Bonus Bet Token equal to a percentage of your original stake, up to 100%. Bonus Bet Tokens expire 7 days after being credited.

DESCRIPTION OF PROMOTION (MECHANIC)

This promotion will be offered at the sole discretion of Bally Bet during the Promotional Period (defined below). Patrons who utilize a Second Chance Bet Token on a real-money wager will be eligible to receive a Bonus Bet Token in the event their wager is settled as a loss. Award will be equal to a specified percentage of the original stake and will be awarded as a Bonus Bet Token within 24 hours of your Qualifying Wager settling as a loss.

WHEN

This promotion will be offered at the sole discretion of Bally Bet between 12:00 a.m. ET on [PUBLISHING DATE], and 11:59 p.m. ET on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

HOW

To participate, eligible Patrons must place a real-money wager using a Second Chance Bet Token during the Promotional Period. If the Qualifying Wager is settled as a loss, the Patron will receive a Bonus Bet Token equal to a percentage of their original stake, up to 100%, within 24 hours of the wager being settled as a loss.

WHAT

This Promotion offers Patrons a chance to receive a percentage of their stake back as a Bonus Bet Token if their Qualifying Wager is settled as a loss, up to a maximum of 100%. Bonus Bet Tokens must be used within 7 days of being issued.

Terms and Conditions

1. PROMOTION PERIOD

1.1. This promotion will be offered at various points to registered and fully verified Patrons between 12:00 a.m. ET on July 1, 2026, and 11:59 p.m. ET on Thursday, December 31, 2026 (the “Promotional Period”).

2. ELIGIBILITY

2.1. To be eligible for this promotion, you must:

(a) Be twenty-one years of age or over;

(b) Not be excluded or self-excluded by law from using the Platform as set forth in Section 4.1.6 of our Platform Terms and Conditions ;

(c) Be fully verified as a Patron on Bally Bet;

(d) At the time of wagering, be physically located in Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Rhode Island, Tennessee, or Virginia.

2.2. Employees of Bally’s Corporation and group companies, and their immediate family members, their affiliates and subsidiaries are not permitted to participate in this Promotion.

2.3. Please visit https://play.ballybet.com/account/terms for additional eligibility information.

3. ACTION REQUIRED

3.1. This Promotion will be offered during the Promotional Period to registered and fully verified Patrons. To participate in this Promotion, you must place a specified wager using a Second Chance Bet Token on the Platform (a “Qualifying Wager”). If the Qualifying Wager utilizing the Second Chance Bet Token is settled as a loss, the Patron will receive a percentage of their original stake back (up to 100%) in the form of a Bonus Bet Token.

4. CLAIMING PROMOTIONAL OFFER

4.1. This promotion is available to registered and fully verified Patrons who are eligible to receive a Second Chance Bet Token in the Patron's Rewards Tab. The Token can be used to place a Qualifying Wager. If the Qualifying Wager results in a loss, the Patron will receive a Bonus Bet Token equal to a percentage of their original stake (up to 100%) within 24 hours of the wager being settled.

4.2. If a Patron’s Qualifying Wager utilizing the Second Chance Bet Token is settled as a loss, Patron will receive a Bonus Bet Token equal to a percentage of their original stake as detailed in the Patron’s Rewards Tab, up to 100% to use on an eligible wager.

4.3. Bonus Bet Token will be loaded to qualifying Patrons’ Bally Bet account within 24 hours of their wager settling as a loss.

4.4. Bonus Bet Tokens will expire 7 days after issuance.

5. REGISTRATION PROCEDURES

5.1. This promotion is only available to registered and fully verified Patrons. To register for a Bally Bet account, please download the Bally Bet Sportsbook mobile application from your app store or visit play.ballybet.com.

6. RESTRICTIONS/EXCLUSIONS

6.1. Bonus Bet Tokens cannot be used with the Second Chance Bet Token.

6.2. A Patron must select the Second Chance Bet Token from the Patron’s Reward tab before placing the wager to apply the promotion.

6.3. Cash out voids participation. If your wager is voided for any reason, the promotion is cancelled and cannot be applied to another wager.

6.4. If your wager is settled as a push, then the promotion will not be applied, and the Patron’s next wager will not be eligible for the promotion.

7. CANCELLATION

7.1. Patrons may cancel participation in this promotion by contacting Customer Support by emailing support@nj.ballybet.com (NJ Only), support@ballybet.com or visiting help.ballybet.com.

8. SECOND CHANCE BET TOKEN

8.1. Second Chance Bet Tokens can be used on Qualifying Wagers as specified in the Rewards Tab on a Patron’s account.

8.2. If a Patron’s Qualifying Wager is settled as a loss, the Patron will be awarded a Bonus Bet Token to use on their next Qualifying Wager.

8.3. If a Patron’s Qualifying Wager using a Second Chance Bet Token is settled as a win, no Bonus Bet Token will be issued.

8.4. Additional usage restrictions may apply, please see Rewards Tab within the My Bets section of your account for additional details.

9. BONUS BET TOKENS

9.1. Bonus Bet Token will be loaded to qualifying Patrons’ Bally Bet account within 24 hours of their wager settling as a loss.

9.2. Bonus Bet Tokens can only be used on Qualifying Wagers as specified in the Rewards Tab on a Patron’s account.

9.3. Additional usage restrictions may apply, please see Rewards Tab within the My Bets section of your account for additional details.

9.4. Bonus Bet Token amount will be equal to specified percentage of original stake as detailed in Rewards Tab.

9.5. Bonus Bet Tokens will expire 7 days after issuance.

10. RESTRICTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL

10.1. Bonus Bet Tokens cannot be withdrawn as cash. Wagers utilizing a Bonus Bet Token are not eligible for the “Cash Out” feature. Bonus Bet Tokens are non-withdrawable, but any winnings therefrom are immediately withdrawable.

11. RESPONSIBLE GAMING

11.1. We want our Patrons at Bally Bet to enjoy their favorite events and to wager responsibly. Gambling problem? Call1-800-GAMBLER or the National problem Gambling Helpline number at 1-800-MY-RESET (1800-697-3738), or in:

Arizona: If you or someone you know has a gambling problem and wants help, call 1-800-NEXT-STEP or text NEXTSTEP to 53342 or visit https://problemgambling.az.gov for confidential help 24 hours a day;

Illinois: Play responsibly. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER;

Indiana: If you or someone you know has a gambling problem and wants help, call 1-800-9-WITH-IT;

Iowa: call 1-800-BETS-OFF or visit yourlifeiowa.org/gambling;

Maryland: Please play responsibly. For help, visit mdgamblinghelp.org;

Massachusetts: Hope is here. call 1-800-327-5050, visit gamblinghelplinema.org, or Live Chat @ PlayWell;

New Jersey: Bet with your head, not over it. Gambling problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER;

New York: call 1-877-HOPENY, text HOPENY (467369), or visit NYProblemGamblingHelp.org;

Ohio: call 1-800-589-9966 or call the National Problem Gambling Helpline number at 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738);

Rhode Island: If you or someone you know has a gambling problem and wants help, call 1-877-9GAMBLE (1-877-942-6253), sponsored by the Rhode Island Lottery. Available 24 hours a day to listen, to help, and provide information;

Tennessee: Gambling Problem? Call or Text the Tennessee REDLINE: 1-800-889-9789 for confidential help 24 hours a day or call the National Problem Gambling Helpline number at 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738);

Virginia: call 1-888-532-3500 or call the National Problem Gambling Helpline number at 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738).

12. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS

12.1. This promotion is subject to Applicable Laws and is void where prohibited or restricted by Applicable Laws.

12.2. Patrons may only utilize this promotion once during the Promotional Period. If Bally’s detects that any Patron has created more than one account (including in order to take part in this promotion multiple times, in breach of these Specific Promotional Terms and Conditions), or is claiming any Bonus Bet Token or taking part in this promotion for the benefit of a group of people, Bally’s may close any such accounts (and void any Bonus Bet Token, wagers, refunds, and/or related winnings).

12.3. Bally’s may, at any time, for any reason, in its sole discretion, and without prior notification, terminate, modify, or suspend this promotion for all Patrons or a selected group of Patrons, and/or cease to offer this promotion to any specific Patron or amend the terms and conditions applicable to this promotion with respect to any specific Patron.

12.4. This promotion cannot be used with any other promotional offer.

12.5. Bally’s is not liable for any imposed sports wagering limits that prevent a Patron from participating in a promotion.

12.6. Bally’s reserves the right to correct any Obvious Error including, but not limited to,

typographical, printing, computer programming or operator errors, including, without limitation, computer errors that erroneously award prizes.

12.7. If a Patron participates in this promotion, the Patron agrees to comply with these Specific Promotional Terms and Conditions, which are subject to and incorporate the Standard Promotional Terms and Conditions, the Sports House Rules, the Additional Sports Wagering Rules (as applicable), and the General Terms and Conditions, all of which form an integral part of these Specific Promotional Terms and Conditions and with which the Patron agrees to comply.

12.8. Any terms not defined in these Specific Promotional Terms and Conditions shall be given the same meaning as set forth in the Standard Promotional Terms and Conditions, then the Sports House Rules, the Additional Sports Wagering Rules (as applicable), and the General Terms and Conditions.

12.9. All Patron information is collected and used by Bally’s in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

12.10. By participating in this promotion and accepting any prize, except where prohibited by law, each prize winner grants Bally’s and its designees permission to use the Patron’s name, photograph, likeness, voice, biographical information, statements, other User Content as (as defined in Bally’s General Terms and Conditions), and address (city and state only) for advertising and/or publicity purposes worldwide and in all forms of media now known or hereafter developed, in perpetuity, without further compensation.

12.11. Bally’s reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to award a Patron an additional promotional opportunity. If Bally’s awards and Patron an additional promotional opportunity, it is not obligated to offer the same or additional promotional opportunities to any other Patron.

12.12. All applicable federal, state, and local taxes will apply. All expenses or costs associated with winnings not mentioned in these Promotional Rules are the sole responsibility of the Patron.

12.13. All taxes and fees payable on winnings resulting from wagers to a Patron’s account, prizes awarded to a Patron from promotions, and Bonus Bet Token

converted to cash in a Patron’s account, and/or any other payments Bally’s may make to a Patron, and all associated tax filings are the Patron’s sole responsibility. No such winnings, prizes, cash, or payments can be transferred, substituted, or redeemed for any other consideration, except with Bally’s prior written consent.

12.14. Bally’s reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to make tax filings or other reports related to a Patron’s use of the Platform or any winnings, prizes, cash, or payments paid to a Patron.
